name: SmelterFurnace
concept: The ore smelting furnace of the quarry works: a squat steel-cased firebrick furnace with a front fire door, a charging hatch on top and a short chimney stack. Players put iron, copper or gold nuggets in at the front and smelt them into bars.
prompt: Small industrial smelting furnace: a squat rectangular riveted steel casing lined with firebrick, a heavy hinged fire door on the front with a small glowing peephole, a round charging hatch with a lid on the top, a short round steel chimney stack at the back of the top, standing on a low brick plinth. no text, no logos.
